summary: Frontend-only testing on viewport 390x844 of new BIBLIA Bible-learning worlds + intro animation. INTRO: intro-animation visible on fresh load (sky+Israel-map art), intro-skip-button dismisses it immediately — PASS. World map journey mode (map-mode-journey) renders all 9 journey-field-* medallions (tora, history, psalms, prophets, gospels, parables, acts, letters, revelation). Navigation: journey-field-{tora,prophets,parables,acts,letters,gospels} all open campaign-screen; journey-field-{history,psalms,revelation} open preview-screen — PASS. /world/gospels shows campaign-chip-{john,matthew,mark,luke}; switching chips updates station nodes (station-node-matthew-1, -mark-1, -luke-1 all present) — PASS. /world/tora shows campaign-chip-{tora-1..tora-5}; station-node-tora-1-1 present on tora-1 — PASS. Historical map toggle (map-mode-history) in /world/tora renders historical-map with tora-themed geo map (Patriarchen & Exodus era) with no crash — PASS. Profile tab lists all 13 book-progress-* rows: john, tora-1..5, matthew, mark, luke, parables, prophets, acts, letters — PASS. /review loads without error — PASS. 0 page errors across all flows. Only warning: pre-existing shadow* deprecation. CRITICAL BLOCKING BUG: adventureNote overlay at the bottom of CampaignScreen (y=780, h=52, pointerEvents=auto) sits directly on top of the first/next-available station node when ZoomableMap focuses it (e.g. station-node-parables-1 at y=765–805). Clicking the node is intercepted by the overlay, so the station-sheet never opens and the user cannot start the first station of parables (and likely tora-1-1, letters-1, prophets-1, acts-1, matthew-1, mark-1, luke-1 — any campaign whose next-available station ends up near the bottom edge due to focus). Clicking a station further up the map (parables-3) correctly opens station-sheet with 'Noch gesperrt', confirming the sheet mechanism itself works — the issue is purely the overlay occlusion for the focused station. SECONDARY BUG: [data-testid="map-zoom-out"] (and likely map-zoom-in) reports getBoundingClientRect = 0x0 even though pointerEvents=auto, visibility=visible, display=flex and the ± round buttons are rendered visually; Playwright refuses to click because "Element is not visible". This suggests the testID is placed on a wrapper that has no measurable size (likely Pressable without an explicit width/height on its outer View, with the Icon being an overflow child). Zoom buttons may not be reliably interactable on web. Could NOT walk the full 7-phase station flow because of blocker #1. All structural prerequisites for the walkthrough are confirmed (station nodes exist for parables-1, tora-1-1, letters-1, prophets-1; task mix includes match/mc/free/order; station-screen testIDs present).

action_items: FIX (critical): Prevent adventureNote overlay from blocking station taps. Add `pointerEvents: 'none'` to the adventureNote container in /app/frontend/app/world/[id].tsx (styles.adventureNote, ~line 220), OR move it above the ZoomableMap's bottom padding, OR shift the ZoomableMap focus upward (e.g. subtract overlay height from focus.y) so nextAvail nodes are never obscured.

FIX (medium): Ensure map-zoom-in / map-zoom-out Pressables have explicit width/height (e.g. 44x44) so they are visible to accessibility/testing — currently their bbox is 0×0 despite the Icon rendering.
RETEST after fix: full 7-phase walkthrough for parables-1 (match task + API verses from Matthäus 13), tora-1-1 (order/free task), letters-1 (mc), prophets-1 (match). Verify phase-complete XP badge.
critical_code_review_comments: world/[id].tsx CampaignScreen correctly routes playable worlds (status='playable' && campaignIds.length) to CampaignScreen and others to PreviewScreen; new worlds (parables, acts, letters, prophets, matthew/mark/luke under gospels, tora-1..5 under tora) are registered in WORLDS and campaignIds — verified via navigation.

CampaignScreen passes focus={x: nextAvail.x, y: nextAvail.y} to ZoomableMap but does not account for the bottom overlay band (adventureNote / legend). Combined with mapH > viewport height, this causes the focused next-available node to render exactly inside the overlay's y-range.

Consider gating via session/AsyncStorage so it only plays once per app launch, not on every web-preview page refresh.

rca_of_issue: RCA: In /app/frontend/app/world/[id].tsx the CampaignScreen renders <ZoomableMap focus={{x: nextAvail.x, y: nextAvail.y}}> with the ZoomableMap container filling flex:1 of the screen. Overlaid absolutely at the bottom (`position:'absolute', bottom: insets.bottom+12`) is the adventureNote View with no `pointerEvents` prop (defaults to 'auto' in RN Web → DOM pointer-events:auto). The ZoomableMap internally centers focus.{x,y} within its container viewport. Because the map is tall (campaign.mapH ~ several thousand px) and focus is just centered, nextAvail typically lands near the vertical center of the ZoomableMap container, which — minus the bottom reserved area for legend/overlay (right:80 anchored but left-side spans ~294px wide at y=780–832) — ends up directly under the overlay for campaigns where the first station is on the bottom row of the campaign map (parables-1, tora-1-1, letters-1, prophets-1 all layout at high y in their respective maps). Reproduction: Open /world/parables (via journey-field-parables), observe station-node-parables-1 bounding box at y=765, Abenteuerkarte-overlay at y=780 h=52; clicks on the node coordinates are intercepted by the overlay (document.elementFromPoint returns the overlay View). Mitigation: set `pointerEvents:'none'` on styles.adventureNote (and optionally styles.legend text block, keeping only interactive children with pointerEvents:'auto'), or inset ZoomableMap.focus.y upward by ≈overlay-height so nextAvail nodes clear the overlay band.
